items.headline: Greed rebounds to 86 while valuation remains at 85
items.summary: The 26 August AGCI snapshot places Greed at 86/100, up 2 points daily, while Valuation remains 85/100. The regime is Mid Bull, confidence is 73/100 and the matrix remains EUPHORIA_RISK — Capital preservation / Do not chase. The S&P 500 closed 25 August at 7,677.28 and VIX eased to 15.45.
items.whyItMatters: The prior cooling in psychology partially reversed without any valuation relief. AGCI therefore does not interpret Tuesday's technology rebound as a broad risk-on confirmation and preserves liquidity ahead of Nvidia and Jackson Hole.
items.agciSignal: GREED REACCELERATES / VALUATION STILL EXTREME / DO NOT CHASE

items.headline: July PCE stays sticky at 3.7% while Q2 GDP remains 1.5%
items.category: Macro / Federal Reserve / Rates / Capital Allocation
items.summary: July headline PCE rose 0.2% month over month and 3.7% year over year, above the 3.6% consensus; core PCE rose 0.2% monthly and 3.3% annually, in line with expectations. The second estimate of Q2 real GDP remained 1.5% annualized.
items.whyItMatters: Inflation is not falling fast enough to justify an aggressive duration or growth multiple expansion. Sticky inflation plus soft-but-positive growth keeps the Fed debate hawkish and preserves a high hurdle rate for long-duration equities and leveraged real estate.
items.agciSignal: STICKY PCE / NO CLEAR RATE RELIEF / KEEP DURATION STAGGERED

items.newsletter: The Barron's Daily — Nvidia's Big Day — 26 Aug 2026
items.headline: Nvidia must validate the AI trade while software faces a separate disruption test
items.summary: Barron's frames Nvidia's report as the immediate test for semiconductors and the AI trade after recent weakness, while noting that software remains under heavier pressure from AI disruption concerns. Salesforce, Okta and Nutanix are among companies reporting after the close, broadening the test beyond chips.
items.whyItMatters: AI is no longer a single-factor semiconductor trade. AGCI separates infrastructure demand from application-layer disruption and requires post-earnings evidence on margins, demand quality, monetization and customer economics before increasing exposure.
items.agciSignal: AI TEST BROADENS / INFRASTRUCTURE ≠ SOFTWARE / WAIT FOR EARNINGS CONFIRMATION

items.headline: Semiconductors lead Tuesday's rebound while broader risk appetite returns selectively
items.summary: Barron's reported the S&P 500 and Dow up 0.3% and the Nasdaq up 0.7% on 25 August, with the iShares Semiconductor ETF up 1.6%. Bitcoin briefly moved above $80,000 and remained more than 14% higher over five days, showing renewed appetite for risk ahead of Nvidia.
items.whyItMatters: The rebound was concentrated rather than broad. Because AGCI Greed rose again to 86 while Valuation stayed 85, the move is treated as a tactical risk rebound, not evidence that valuation risk has cleared.
items.agciSignal: CONCENTRATED RISK REBOUND / GREED REACCELERATES / BREADTH CONFIRMATION NEEDED

items.headline: Oil falls toward two-week lows as Iran-Oman talks raise hopes for a partial Hormuz reopening
items.summary: Iran and Oman discussed a temporary navigational corridor and mine-clearing arrangements through the Strait of Hormuz. Brent fell roughly 2%–3% toward the mid-$80s, but physical traffic remained depressed, with only five commodity vessels transiting Tuesday versus a 10-day average of 15.
items.whyItMatters: Lower oil reduces near-term inflation pressure and helps bonds, but the physical normalization is not yet complete. AGCI reduces the need to add energy hedges after the drop while retaining a modest tail hedge until shipping volumes normalize.
items.agciSignal: HORMUZ DE-ESCALATION HOPE / OIL RISK PREMIUM FALLS / KEEP SMALL TAIL HEDGE

items.headline: New-home sales fall 10.5% in July as mortgage rates near 6.8% constrain demand
items.summary: U.S. new single-family home sales fell 10.5% in July to a 607,000 annualized pace, the lowest since January. The median new-home price fell to $393,800, a four-year low, while the 30-year mortgage rate was around 6.77% in mid-August and consumer home-buying intentions weakened sharply.
items.whyItMatters: Housing remains a direct transmission channel from long yields to the real economy. AGCI keeps real-estate underwriting at +50/+100 bp stress and requires robust DSCR rather than assuming imminent mortgage relief.
items.agciSignal: HOUSING DEMAND WEAK / HIGH MORTGAGE RATES BITE / KEEP UNDERWRITING STRESS
